description: Defines a custom data type for boolean values in the OpenMRS platform. The class extends SerializingCustomDatatype to implement serialization and deserialization of Boolean objects.

classes.name: BooleanDatatype
classes.description: A data type class for handling boolean values in OpenMRS, with methods to serialize and deserialize Boolean objects.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts a Boolean object into its string representation, or null if the input is null.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts a string into a Boolean object; returns null if the string is empty or null.
